summary: Use em dashes without surrounding spaces (or double hyphens if unavailable); they can replace commas or parentheses for emphasis, omit surrounding punctuation, and only one is used at the end of a sentence.
questions: Should there be spaces around em dashes?
When should I use dashes instead of parentheses?
What if I can't type an em dash?

answer_card.title: Em dashes
answer_card.answer_md: No spaces around em dashes; use `--` without spaces if needed. A pair can replace commas (more emphatic) or parentheses (less formal, more attention). Drop the surrounding punctuation, and use a single dash at the end of a sentence.
